theme.archetype: Archetype 4 (Swiss & High-Contrast) fused with Archetype 1 (Organic & Earthy)
theme.description: Security-tech but warm and human. Moves away from dystopian 'Big Brother' and generic purple/blue tech SaaS. Uses high-contrast structural hierarchy (Swiss) grounded with warm tints like bone-white, deep obsidian, and safety amber (Organic/Human) to build trust. Dark-mode first for visitor/video screens to prioritize the camera feed, Light/Dark adaptive for admin and resident dashboards for readability.

fonts.heading: Cabinet Grotesk
fonts.installation: Ensure fonts are imported via Google Fonts or Fontshare in index.css

typography.instructions: CRITICAL: DO NOT use Inter or Roboto. Use Cabinet Grotesk for high-impact, editorial headings. Use Outfit for readable, slightly geometric body copy. Use JetBrains Mono exclusively for data points like timestamps, unit numbers, and QR pass codes to emphasize the 'tech/security' feel.

colors.description: Warm bone-white background for light mode instead of pure white. Deep obsidian for dark mode. High-contrast safety amber for alerts/actions. Forest Slate for structural trust.

layout_spacing.grid: Use the Bento Grid Protocol (Mode B for Dashboards). grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 for dense dashboards with gap-6. Every pixel utilized.
layout_spacing.spacing_scale: Generous. Use p-6 or p-8 for standard cards. Containers with borders MUST have internal padding to prevent collision.
layout_spacing.radius: Nested radii. Main containers `rounded-xl`, inner elements `rounded-md`.
layout_spacing.alignment: Optical alignment over geometrical. Left-align labels and dense forms. Use asymmetry for landing page storytelling.

components.cards: Flat solid background with 1px delicate inner stroke (`border-border`). Never use soft muddy shadows. On hover: slight lift `-translate-y-1` and sharp shadow.
components.status_pills: Solid pill with high contrast. Active: `bg-primary text-primary-foreground`. Pending: `bg-accent text-accent-foreground`.
components.call_controls: Large, tactile circular buttons. Use Glassmorphism `backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/60` container for floating call controls positioned at the bottom of the full-screen video.
components.navigation: Dashboards: Vertical sidebar with mono-accent labels. Guard dash: Horizontal top-bar to maximize vertical space for the visitor queue.
components.buttons: Primary: Solid block. Secondary: Outline with transparent background. Always enforce hover text color explicitly.

motion_interactions.hover: Hover states must increase contrast. `hover:text-primary hover:bg-muted`.
motion_interactions.incoming_call: Pulsing ring animation using `animate-ping` on a pseudo-element behind the answer button. Glass overlay fades in smoothly.
motion_interactions.status_pulse: Live WebRTC or online indicators get a tiny 6px green/amber dot with `animate-pulse`.
motion_interactions.page_entrance: Staggered fade-up for dashboard lists. Transition: `transform 0.2s ease, opacity 0.2s ease`.

layouts.landing_page: High visual impact. Asymmetric 'Bento' hero section (grid-cols-12). Huge Cabinet Grotesk typography. High-contrast gradient overlays (`bg-gradient-to-r from-black/70 to-transparent`) on apartment images.
layouts.auth_screens: Split screen. Left: Beautiful architecture image. Right: Minimalist form using Shadcn inputs with warm bone-white background.
layouts.resident_dashboard: Light mode by default. Welcome message. 3-column layout. Left: Call History feed. Center/Right: Quick Generate Visitor Pass (QR code) & Pending Approvals.
layouts.admin_dashboard: Data-heavy 'Control Room' Grid. Top row: Key metrics (Total Units, Active Guards, Daily Visitors) with Mono stats. Bottom: Data tables for activity logs.
layouts.guard_dashboard: High-contrast. Split view. Left: Live Visitor Queue (tall narrow feed with photos). Right: Manual Entry Approval form and live QR Scanner feed.
layouts.incoming_call_screen: Dark-mode ONLY. Full-screen video feed. Gradient overlay `bg-gradient-to-t from-black/80 via-transparent to-black/40` for text visibility. Floating crystal glass call controls.
layouts.visitor_kiosk: Dark mode, ultra-simplified. Massive 'Tap to Call Resident' CTA. Unit search with numpad. JetBrains Mono for unit numbers.
layouts.qr_pass_screen: Mobile-optimized ticket view. Bright background. Monospace font for the pass code. Large prominent QR code card with dashed borders (ticket aesthetic).

accessibility_and_testing.testing_attributes: CRITICAL: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute. Applies to: buttons, links, form inputs, menus, error messages, user balances, confirmation text. Convention: kebab-case, role-based. Example: `data-testid="call-accept-button"`.
accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure contrast > 4.5:1. Never use pure transparent backgrounds over images if text is overlaid. Use text-shadow or gradient scrims.
accessibility_and_testing.focus: Focus states must have HIGHER contrast, e.g. `focus:ring-2 focus:ring-accent`.

tech_stack_instructions.file_type: Use .js files (JavaScript + React), NOT .tsx. Provide prop-types or inline comments for component APIs if necessary.
tech_stack_instructions.ui_library: Use Shadcn/UI for complex components (Dialogs, Dropdowns). Customize styles to match the 'Swiss & High-Contrast + Organic Tints' theme. Do not use default Vercel aesthetic.
